name: Profadol
summary: Profadol (CI-572) is an opioid analgesic which was developed in the 1960s by Parke-Davis. It acts as a mixed agonist-antagonist of the μ-opioid receptor. The analgetic potency is about the same as of pethidine (meperidine), the antagonistic effect is 1/50 of nalorphine.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a mixed agonist-antagonist of the μ-opioid receptor.

summaryZh: 普羅法朵（英語：Profadol，研發代號：CI-572）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C14H21NO，1960年代由Parke-Davis公司以類阿片鎮痛藥研發，其鎮痛效力與哌替啶大致相同，拮抗作用是烯丙嗎啡的約1/50。
summaryZhHans: 普罗法朵（英语：Profadol，研发代号：CI-572）是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C14H21NO，1960年代由Parke-Davis公司以类阿片镇痛药研发，其镇痛效力与哌替啶大致相同，拮抗作用是烯丙吗啡的约1/50。
